failure_artifact.error: Model snapshot path escaped its root

root_cause: Hugging Face snapshot entries are legitimate symlinks from snapshots/<revision> to blobs within the same models--Salesforce--blipdiffusion-controlnet cache root. The first implementation incorrectly required each resolved target to remain under snapshots/<revision>.

locked_fix.manifest_relative_path: Reject absolute paths and every '..' component.
locked_fix.symlink_target_boundary: Allow a resolved target only inside the same Hugging Face model cache root that contains blobs, refs, and snapshots.
locked_fix.content_validation: Keep exact size and SHA256 verification for every model file and the locked total byte count.
locked_fix.test_requirement: Cover valid in-root files and reject parent traversal before the retry.
